title: OLE AuditEvent
description: A structured log record of a consequential OLE action. Draft schema — v0.1.

id.description: Stable identifier for this audit event.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this audit event was created.

actor.description: OLE Actor ID of the actor who performed the action.

actorType.description: Type of actor that performed the action.

resourceType_ref.description: OLE resource type that was acted upon, e.g., 'Referral', 'ConsentRecord'.

resourceId.description: OLE ID of the resource that was acted upon.

note.description: Optional human-readable note about the event.

aiAudit.description: Additional audit fields required when actorType is 'ai_agent'.

logInputs.description: Structured record of inputs provided to the AI agent for this action.

logOutputs.description: Structured record of outputs produced by the AI agent.

logDecisionRationale.description: Human-readable summary of the reasoning behind the AI decision.

logEvidenceReferences.description: OLE IDs or external references for documents, rules, or data sources consulted.

logModelVersion.description: Version identifier of the AI model used.

logPolicyVersion.description: Version identifier of the policy or constraint set applied.
